title: Calibrated classifier posterior odds recover component density ratios
statement: With known class priors, posterior odds recover component density ratios, which can then be transformed into the local mixture score.
assumptions: true full-observation posterior probabilities P(Y=a|X=x), not merely reliability-calibrated probabilities
known strictly positive training priors; the same class-conditional component laws

proof_location.section: O3. Calibrated classifier posteriors provide ratios

warning: Reliability calibration alone identifies density ratios of the forecast representation, not necessarily the full observation; see O8.4 and AUDIT-SCORE-ERROR-BUDGET-001.
